content:
oncall-ash: Heads-up: embedder eu-west1 is returning elevated 5xx ~6% after the midnight spool. Quick fix landed in image embedder:v2.1.4-kv-hotfix. Requesting immediate hotpatch and skip of the 10m canary for region-only.

deploy-bot: HOTFIX REQUEST: service=embedder region=eu-west1 image=embedder:v2.1.4-kv-hotfix trigger=alert-embed-5xx

nina: Can you summarize the risk? Is config/schema changing?

oncall-ash: No schema change. Cause: KV index off-by-one introduced in v2.1.3 -> decoder errors. Patch is one-line fix, unit tests + small integ tests pass locally.

security-maya: Image scanned. No new privileges. +1 security.

loren: SRE: small diff, ok to expedite if we have rollback gates and smoke tests. Add an automatic cutback if node restart count > 2 in 3m.

pm-raquel: Product: fine, please post the short release blurb so I can update status page.

eng-lead-janet: I can approve skip-canary for eu-west1 only under these conditions: explicit rollback triggers, run smoke script, notify support, and set 15m post-check.

oncall-ash: Proposed rollback criteria:
- sustained 5xx > 1% for 3 consecutive minutes
- p95 latency +250ms over baseline for 5 minutes
- logs showing "kv-index-err" after rollout

loren: add: node restart >2 in 3m -> instant 50% traffic cutback. Also run KV prefix invalidation job after deploy.

eng-lead-janet: good. Support will be pinged.

deploy-bot: APPROVALS RECEIVED (4). Executing deploy: skip_canary=true rollout=region-only eu-west1

deploy-bot: step 1/4 drain old pods -> OK
deploy-bot: step 2/4 apply new image -> OK
deploy-bot: step 3/4 run smoke: `./ci/smoke/embedder_check --region eu-west1`

oncall-ash: smoke x12 queries PASSED, no 5xx observed. Logs indicate kv index fix.

deploy-bot: step 3/4 smoke -> PASS
deploy-bot: step 4/4 finalize roll -> 100% traffic
deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Telemetry: 5xx returned to baseline, p95 stable.

oncall-ash: Support notified, status page updated (INC-7621). Scheduling +15m verification. Postmortem ticket created: https://pm.internal/RED-4567

pm-raquel: Release note: "embedder: KV cache indexing fix to address intermittent 5xx in eu-west1."

loren: leaving follow-up to check cross-region metrics and re-run KV invalidation tomorrow morning.

eng-lead-janet: Incident mitigated, great turnaround. Will collect RCA after metrics settle.

deploy-bot: AUTO: If rollback needed run `/deploy rollback embedder eu-west1 embedder:v2.1.3`

nina: Thanks team. :rocket:
